title: Partition Equal Subset Sum
summary: Decide whether an array of positive integers can be split into two groups with the same sum (0/1 knapsack).

tests.explain: The total is 8, so each group needs 4, and no subset adds up to 4.
The total, 7, is odd: two equal halves are impossible.

hints: If the total is odd, the answer is false. Otherwise the question becomes: does some subset add up to exactly total / 2?
That is 0/1 knapsack with booleans: reachable[i][s] says whether some of the first i numbers sum to s. Each number is either left out or used once.
With one row: reachable[0] = true, and for each number x loop s from target DOWN to x, setting reachable[s] ||= reachable[s - x]. Going down keeps x from being used twice.

complexity.time: O(n × S): n numbers times target sums up to S = total / 2
